content: Bu Kunyid Kawernmerren Kadberre Wanjh Karridi Yiwarrudj.
Ngudda Yawey kanbidyikarrmen! Birriwern bininj nawu ngundiwoybukwong nakka wanjh birridarrkidyakminj rowk! Nawu birrimak bininj ngudda ke, wanjh bonj, minj kabirrihni kondah kurorre.
Bininj rowk kabirrikurrekurren bu kabirrikowerren, dja minj nangale mak nawoybuk dja kabirridjalkurren munguyh.
Wanjh birrimekbe nawu kabirrihburlumerren yiddok minj yibendjendjobdjobke?

Bedda wanjh kabirrihburluburlumerren dja kanjdji baybaywi kabirriyimerren, “Ngad wanjh ngarriyolyolme kore ngad ngarridjare, dja minj nangale kandabke. Dja wanjh karriwokdangen ba bu karrimang rowk manbu karridjare!”

Wanjh Yawey kayime, “Mah. Ngaye ngarrolkkan dja ngabenbidyikarrme bininj nawu birringudjwarre dja mak nawu birrimarladj Ngabenbekkan bedda kabirrikayhme dja ngabenkukdjurruddan ba bu birriwarre bininj minj kabindimarneyime kunwarre.” Kuhni yimeng nawu Yawey.
Dja nawu Yawey wanjh nawoybuk kore kawokkurrmerren, wanjh manbu kunwok nuye makka yiman kayime silver manbu bininj kabirriwolngwon seven times kore kunak.
O Yawey, kankukbalhmen ngadberre kore nawu birriwarre bininj ngandiwirrihme. Kannahna ba bu ngarringehme munguyh munguyh.
Nawu birriwarre bininj wanjh kabirrihdjalrengehre bu kabirriburluburlumerren, dja birridjalwern nakka kabirriburlumerren kore kundjalwarre duninjh kabirrikurduyime.
